text:
Olivia: Heads-up — onboarding 'zenith-7b' today. quick check: where are the canonical weights stored and any known tokenizer quirks?
Sam: /s3/redwood-models/zenith/7b/v1/weights.tar.gz and model-metadata.json in same dir.
Raj: note: tokenizer uses legacy BOS token id 1 instead of 0 — causes off-by-one in some our padding logic. should we remap in loader?
Emily: thanks. loader has a remap flag we can flip (`tokenizer.bos_remap=true`) but current container image at prod uses tokenizers==0.12 which doesn't expose that flag.
Kevin: oof, also the runtime CI is currently pinned to CUDA 12.1 image. Triton plugin we need for zenith-realtime requires CUDA 12.3+ (kernel v2).
Olivia: so two things: (1) either build new container with tokenizers bump and remap flag enabled, or (2) do runtime shim to fix ids. (2) seems faster for a canary.
devops-bot: @Olivia @Kevin opened ticket INF-2143: container-rebuild + cuda bump. links: https://redwood.atlassian/INF-2143
Sam: for the shim, we can add a lightweight map before tokenization: `if tokens[0]==1 and expected_bos==0: tokens = [0]+tokens[1:]` — quick but hacky.
Raj: downside: shim will break decoder KV cache alignment if not applied consistently for prefix caching. would prefer loader-level remap.
Emily: agree with Raj. loader remap + small container rebuild is safer. I can do the rebuild if CI isn't blocked by kernel selection.
Kevin: CI note: current Triton wheels in our image are compiled against cuBLAS that expects cudnn 8.2 — moving to CUDA 12.3 likely needs rebuild of triton and our custom kernels. builds take ~45m on CI.
Olivia: timeline? can we do a fast canary patch (shim) to unblock QA while rebuild runs?
Emily: yes I can submit a canary that sets remap in the request path for the canary model route only. will add clear comment + telemetry.
ci-bot: build triggered for branch emily/zenith-tokenizer-fix (#345). status: queued.
Kevin: also need to pick kernel set: intel-optimized vs generic. zenith benefits from fused attention kernels — prefer fused if CUDA>=12.3. fallback path should be non-fused for older GPUs.
Sam: config proposal (loader + runtime) — putting here for review:
```
model:
  name: zenith-7b
  weights_path: s3://redwood-models/zenith/7b/v1/weights.tar.gz
  tokenizer:
    type: bytepair
    bos_remap: true
runtime:
  triton:
    cuda_version: 12.3
    kernels:
      preferred: fused-attn
      fallback: generic
```
Raj: looks good. add `canary_route: true` field so we don't flip production until CI + perf smoke pass.
Olivia: can you open the CR and tag me? I'll do quick perf check on a small set.
Emily: CR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/678 — pinging reviewers @Raj @Kevin.
Kevin: reviewing now. if CI passes I'll queue the container build on infra runners (we need cuda12.3-capable runners).
Sam: FYI weights have a tiny checksum mismatch on the mirror — verifying origin now. will update ticket.
Olivia: perfect. thanks all — plan: canary shim in next 2hrs, loader+image rebuild in CI next 6hrs, perf smoke and rollback window scheduled. :thumbsup:
